rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: The party website's 'Party Committees/Structure' page says the 16th Congress, 'held between October 5 and 11, 1998', elected a 75-member Central Committee, and that 'The Central Committee at its meeting held on October 11, 1998 at the conclusion of the Congress elected a 17 Member Polit Bureau, with Harkishan Singh Surjeet as the General Secretary'.
